item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description:
First of all, thanks for everyone's support and feedback. Your enthusiasm for FlowIn is something I really didn't expect, and I'm grateful that FlowIn is helping with your daily writing, even in a small way.

Our goal is really to make it much easier to express your intent, and we've been working day and night to make that happen. This update has a few major features I'm excited to share.

  • Draft a full reply anywhere. Tap the right Option (⌥) key in any app, pick a direction, and FlowIn writes the whole reply in your voice.
  • A much faster, smoother local model.
  • Updated shortcuts. Tab accepts word by word, the backtick key (`) accepts the whole suggestion, and right-Command + ↑/↓ cycles alternatives.

item.title: Version 1.0.6.1
item.description:
• Significantly improved Fast model performance, now it is the default model
  • New onboarding step: an "About you" profile that tailors suggestions to how you write
  • Suggestions now default to Phrase length
  • Better Chinese and Japanese input: accept suggestions one character at a time, with smoother overlap handling for non-Latin scripts
  • Longer suggestions can extend one line below the input box
  • Fixes: steadier insertion in Safari, accurate caret alignment in terminals, and fewer duplicated characters

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
• Cycle through 3 alternative suggestions with right-Option + ⌥↓ / ⌥↑ after a partial accept
  • Screen context: keeps OCR fresh during typing, better sender attribution in chat bubbles
  • Onboarding: new keyboard graphics for permission steps and an interactive cycle tutorial
  • App now requires an invite code on first launch — contact us if you need one
  • Fixes around 3-in-1 cycle parsing and special-character edge cases

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
• Suggestions stay aligned even after pasting, deleting, or inserting ChatGPT/Telegram conversation snippets
  • Ghost text now stays put on the active Space and renders over app launchers (Raycast, Spotlight, etc.) instead of disappearing
  • Fewer false-fire suggestions: skip when caret has no preceding text after a click, skip when prefix ends with "?", arrow keys no longer trigger inference, selection mode hides ghost text
  • Onboarding step 2 reveal animation + softer pill buttons
  • DMG now uses drag-to-install layout with an arrow guide

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description: • Auto-update prompts now reliably come to the front so you don't miss them

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
• New first-launch onboarding with permissions setup and an interactive tutorial page
  • Redesigned Settings window with auto-saving User Context, scrollable layout, and new "AI Models" and "Suggestion Length" sections
  • Local model significantly improved across quality, latency, and reliability
  • Better support for typing in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
  • Fixed text insertion edge cases around word boundaries, special characters, and Gmail quoted replies
  • Autocomplete now starts disabled in IDEs on first install (toggle per-app from the menu)

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
• Ghost text now dismisses cleanly on Return, Cmd+A, forward delete, and Emacs-style keybindings
  • Improved ghost text dismissal in search fields and on paste/cut
  • Fixed a crash in text measurement (Double-to-Int overflow)
  • Faster context reads (capped at ~8K chars)

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• Fixed text insertion in Gmail replies with quoted history
  • Added support for terminal emulators (iTerm2, Warp, ghostty, kitty, etc.)
  • Fixed rapid word-by-word acceptance occasionally duplicating words
  • Fixed crash when Chrome's accessibility state became temporarily invalid
  • Detect limited browsers (Firefox/Arc) and show an inline hint

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• Rebranded to FlowIn
  • Improved permission prompts for Screen Context
  • Fixed reliability issues (secure input, sleep/wake, App Nap)
  • Better suggestion display in Outlook and WKWebView apps
  • Smart ghost text persistence on space and delete
  • Clipboard session management for rapid Tab acceptance
  • Redesigned toolbar with collapsible FlowIn widget
  • Timed disable options (15m, 60m, indefinitely)
  • Auto-update support via Sparkle
